purpose: Ingest leading-zero discoveries with high non-physics utility—CMMC guidance, Intel advisories, edge-AI sensing hardware, current S3000L lifecycle-support specification and manufacturing studies—while keeping matched digits as metadata/control classes.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, standard, method, software resource, operational precedent, commercial signal or information item receives a Worldshepherd use when it materially improves any capability, or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Vendor mirrors, alternate landing pages, derivative copies and repeated database records of the same underlying source are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Document IDs, security-advisory IDs, part numbers, postal codes and bibliographic identifiers may be highly useful operationally but have zero automatic Glob evidence unless the digits independently encode a verified physical quantity.

sources.title: CMMC Assessment Guide – Level 2
sources.note: Use as an authoritative assessment-readiness reference for Level 2 self/certification assessments, FCI/CUI protection and evidence preparation. 00003 is the DoD guidance identifier.

sources.title: CMMC Scoping Guide – Level 1
sources.note: Use to structure Level 1 asset/system scoping and CMMC boundary decisions. 00005 is the guidance identifier.

sources.title: Intel SNMP Subagent Stand-Alone Advisory for Windows
sources.note: Use as a legacy-product retirement/failure-mode precedent: uncontrolled installer search path can enable privilege escalation; Intel recommends discontinuing the product. 00300 is the advisory ID.

sources.title: Intel Centrino Wireless Driver Malformed Frame Privilege Escalation
sources.note: Use as a driver/input-validation failure-mode reference involving malformed requests and memory corruption. 00005 is the advisory ID.

sources.title: AXIS F9104-B Mk II Main Unit
sources.note: Use as an edge-AI multisensor/video architecture reference: four channels, DLPU analytics, hardware-backed Edge Vault, SBOM/integrity support, H.264/H.265 and ruggedized modular integration. 03000 is the part-number prefix.

sources.title: S3000L Issue 3.0 — Logistic Support Analysis
sources.note: Use the current LSA/Integrated Product Support framework for lifecycle support, maintenance analysis, product breakdown, resource planning, structured data exchange, availability/cost tradeoffs and support-engineering integration. It is retained because the 03000 raw scan surfaced the S3000L document-code neighborhood; S3000L itself is not Glob evidence.

sources.title: Microstructure and residual stress at diffusion bonded interface between vanadium and Ti-6Al-4V
sources.note: Use interface microstructure, diffusion-bond processing, XRD and residual-stress characterization as an advanced joining/materials reference. 00005 is DOI metadata.

sources.title: A laser based process for the formation of a local back surface field for n-type silicon solar cells
sources.authority: Thin Solid Films / indexed by IAEA INIS
sources.note: Use controllable laser doping/passivation opening as a precision local-processing precedent; 00300 is a PII component.

information_updates.finding: The official DoD 00003/00005 guidance pair gives Worldshepherd a concrete assessment/scoping reference for CMMC work tied to defense capture and production readiness.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The guidance identifiers are M1 raw controls and do not affect Glob evidence.

information_updates.finding: S3000L Issue 3.0 broadens Worldshepherd's lifecycle framework beyond design/build into logistic support analysis, maintainability, task analysis, support resources, cost/availability tradeoffs, in-service support and structured data exchange.
information_updates.claims_boundary: S3000L is a utility source, not numerical evidence.

information_updates.finding: Axis couples edge analytics with secure key storage, software integrity hashes and SBOM publication; this is a strong reference pattern for Worldshepherd sensor-node cybersecurity and software-supply-chain transparency.

next_actions: Continue source-by-source retroactive utility coverage and raw scanning across the remaining 208-state union, including software, security, manufacturing, operations, governance and commercial sources.
Map applicable S3000L lifecycle-support concepts into Worldshepherd production/readiness governance without claiming formal compliance until implemented and audited.
Continue same-system topology and relational verification independently for physical P1/P2 candidates.
Maintain fixed tolerance and experiment-wide multiple-testing/false-discovery controls for numerical evidence promotion.
